root = Stack([title, nearestCallout, kpiRow, mainContent], 16)

title = Text("30-Day Filing Deadline Board", "heading")

dashboard = Query("host_getDashboard", {}, {"clientsMissingDocs": 0, "documentsOutstanding": 0, "documentsReceived": 0, "documentsTotal": 0, "clientsTotal": 0, "nearestDeadline": "", "nearestDeadlineClient": {"id": "", "businessName": "", "filingDeadline": ""}})
deadlines = Query("host_listDeadlines", {}, [])

nearestCallout = Callout("Nearest deadline: " + dashboard.nearestDeadlineClient.businessName + " due on " + dashboard.nearestDeadline, "warning", "Approaching Filing Deadline")

totalCount = @Count(deadlines)
totalStat = Stat("Total Upcoming", totalCount, "number")
docsOutStat = Stat("Outstanding Documents", dashboard.documentsOutstanding, "number", null, "accent")
missingClientsStat = Stat("Clients Missing Docs", dashboard.clientsMissingDocs, "number", null, "danger")

kpiRow = Row([totalStat, docsOutStat, missingClientsStat], 12)

tableCols = [{key: "businessName", label: "Client"}, {key: "entityType", label: "Entity Type"}, {key: "filingDeadline", label: "Filing Deadline", format: "date"}, {key: "status", label: "Status"}, {key: "assignee.name", label: "Assigned Staff"}]
deadlinesTable = DataTable(deadlines, tableCols, "filingDeadline asc", 20, ["status", "entityType"], true, 10, "No upcoming deadlines found.")

cardFields = [{key: "filingDeadline", label: "Deadline", format: "date"}, {key: "entityType", label: "Entity"}, {key: "contactName", label: "Contact Person"}, {key: "contactEmail", label: "Email"}]
deadlinesCards = CardList(deadlines, "businessName", "status", cardFields, 3, "No deadline cards to display.")

tab1 = {label: "Schedule Table", content: deadlinesTable}
tab2 = {label: "Client Cards", content: deadlinesCards}
